content.text: Please refrain from sharing or leaving food unattended in the pressbox. It is against the health and safety protocols. The rules state that you can bring food in for yourself. Thank you.
So if I put it next to my seat that’s ok
As long as it’s for you and only you. Can’t leave food out. Thanks
I will tweet so the rest of them know
You can put people at risk, seriously
So you told me about this and then you tell my editor?
